native_result.query: What kind of demographic disparities exist in median wealth in 1985 among individuals who were ever incarcerated?
native_result.HypoA: Gender disparities exist in median wealth in 1985 among individuals who were ever incarcerated, with males having higher median wealth than females.
native_result.HypoB: Among individuals ever incarcerated (ever_jailed==1, n=289), median 1985 wealth is very low overall ($720) and shows two consistent demographic disparities. (1) A dominant RACIAL gradient: median 1985 wealth is White $2,200 (n=69) > Black $320 (n=159) > Hispanic $0 (n=61), with White roughly 7x the Black median and effectively unbounded above the $0 Hispanic median. (2) A SEX gap: Male $1,000 (n=252) > Female $0 (n=37). Combined (race x sex), among males the racial gradient holds (White $2,000 > Black $800 > Hispanic $700), while all female cells are at/near $0 (Black $0, Hispanic $0); the White-female $4,100 figure rests on only n=12 and is unstable, so it should not be over-interpreted. All incarcerated medians are well below non-incarcerated counterparts (e.g., overall $720 vs $3,600; White $2,200 vs $5,700), consistent with a wealth penalty of incarceration. Limitations: ever_jailed is a 1985-1994 window, so for those jailed after 1985 the 1985 wealth is pre-incarceration (temporal-validity caveat); the incarcerated female cells (n=9-16) are small; and ever_jailed is a windowed proxy for 'ever incarcerated'.
native_result.WorkflowB: Loaded data/nls_incarceration_processed.csv (12,013 rows; 0 missing in race, sex, ever_jailed, composite_wealth_1985). Defined the incarcerated subset as ever_jailed==1 (n=289). Computed the median of composite_wealth_1985 (pandas .median, linear interpolation) for the whole subset and by race (white/black/hipanic), by sex (male/female), and by the six race x sex cells, reporting n per cell. Computed the same medians for the non-incarcerated subset (ever_jailed==0, n=11,724) as context. Kept 'hipanic' verbatim in code and labeled it Hispanic in the narrative; flagged small-cell instability and the 1985-wealth temporal-validity caveat. Script: analysis.py; per-stratum medians saved to results_inc_median_1985.csv.
